description:
The heliocentric speed readout on the /fly HUD displays 'NaN km/s' for every outer-planet mission (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Ceres, Psyche) throughout the entire transit. Readout is rendered at src/routes/fly/+page.svelte:6783 via heliocentricKms.toFixed(2).

Expected: A finite numeric km/s value in the HUD speed readout at all times during outer-planet missions. When the spacecraft's heliocentric radius exceeds the apohelion of the nominal transfer orbit (such that the vis-viva radicand goes negative), the displayed speed should fall back to the local circular orbital speed sqrt(mu / r). At radius r = 0 the displayed speed must be 0.

Acceptance criteria:
- Outer-planet missions (jupiter, saturn, uranus, neptune, pluto, ceres, psyche) on /fly must display a finite numeric km/s value in the HUD speed readout, never 'NaN km/s'. [reporter: the HUD speed readout just says 'NaN km/s' the whole way']
- When the spacecraft heliocentric radius r is such that (2/r − 1/a) < 0 (vis-viva radicand negative), the speed readout must fall back to local circular orbital speed: sqrt(μ / r) × (AU/yr→km/s), where μ = 4π² (AU³/yr²) per static repo constants. [reporter: when the spacecraft's radius is beyond the transfer orbit's apohelion (aphelion) — i.e. the vis-viva radicand goes negative — the readout should fall back to the local circular orbital speed at that radius: sqrt(mu / r)]
- At spacecraft heliocentric radius r = 0, the speed readout must display 0, not NaN. [reporter: at radius = 0 it should return 0, not NaN]
- The readout must display speed in km/s (consistent with the existing 'NN km/s' i18n key fly_hud_kms). [reporter: Units are km/s' (explicitly stated by reporter); also verifiable at src/routes/fly/+page.svelte:6783 via fly_hud_kms({ value: ... }) and at src/lib/orbital/fly-physics.ts:37–40 where the function JSDoc documents @returns speed in km/s]
